consumer: A dialogue/condition u_has_items check (conditional_t::set_has_items lambda) asking yes/no: does the character actor currently possess a 1st_aid kit?
scope: only the character's own carried items (wielded/worn/inventory on-person), matching has_amount/has_charges' reach over the character actor
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t<T>::set_has_items builds a predicate lambda returning actor->has_charges(item_id,count) || actor->has_amount(item_id,count), i.e. an engine-computed possession yes/no over the character
divergence: A 1st_aid kit lying on an adjacent tile or in a nearby unworn container: a reachable-inventory or map-region answer reports 'holding' = true, but the on-person possession predicate correctly returns false
